exclusions.source_text: Must not have been diagnosed with any subsequent malignancy that required additional cardiotoxic therapies (i.e., radiotherapy to the chest \[also includes fields directed towards the neck, upper abdomen, or spine\], or additional anthracyclines or anthraquinones); patients with history of subsequent malignancy that did not require such therapies remain eligible
No evidence of poor or low cardiac function at time of initial osteosarcoma diagnosis
exclusions.threshold: shortening fraction >= 28% by echocardiogram or radionuclide ejection fraction >= 50%

exclusions.source_text: Cannot have a known history of congenital heart disease (patent foramen ovale remain eligible)
No exposure to DRZ at any point in time
